content.short: GasPump is a utility platform on TON designed to simplify gas fee management for users and developers.
content.description: GasPump is an innovative utility platform built for the TON blockchain, specifically designed to address and simplify the complexities of gas fee management. It provides tools that enable users to manage their transaction costs more effectively and allows developers to implement 'gasless' or sponsored transactions within their applications. By lowering the technical and financial barriers to on-chain interaction, GasPump enhances the overall user experience and facilitates the broader adoption of decentralized services across the TON network, particularly for new and casual users.
content.meta: Manage your TON gas fees with ease using GasPump. Explore gas-saving tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
